window: DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30 (splits.py DEV_END), 1,313,280 1m bars, 70/30 IS/OOS; not comparable to the older report tables, which run to 2026-09-26

verdict.label: With strict detectors no cell meets the edge rule (OOS n >= 30, net > 0 at h5, PBO < 0.5)

why: Strict cvd_absorption: 5m OOS n 797 net -0.089 % (PBO 0.882), 15m OOS n 154 net -0.108 % (PBO 0.760), 1h OOS n 18 net +0.054 % (PBO 0.562): insufficient n (18 < 30).
Strict escalation: 5m OOS n 1065 net -0.067 % (PBO 0.171), 15m OOS n 291 net -0.079 % (PBO 0.286): a stable zero edge, not an edge; 1h has 0 OOS events (IS n 5).

The strict escalation detector removes the bulk of events (1h grid 117 vs legacy 2,523; 15m 3,775 vs 28,910; 5m 33,676 vs 125,915). The earlier 1h escalation +0.113 % net hypothesis does not survive on DEV.
The recommendations stand: escalation 1h log-only, no weight. These are mechanical readings with guessed thresholds, not Fabio's discretionary read.
